<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">

  <li><strong>Wholesale Inflation:</strong> India&#x27;s WPI inflation eased to 9.78% in July as cooling fuel prices offset rising costs in the food and manufacturing sectors.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a></span></li>
